evidence: The TiO2 thin films were grown by ALD in a Fiji 200 reactor from Veeco/Cambridge Nanotech using TTIP (titanium isopropoxide) or TDMAT (tetrakis(dimethylamino)titanium) as Ti precursors and ultrapure water as oxygen source. The TTIP and TDMAT canisters were heated at 80◦C while the water tank was left at room temperature.
